messages:
carmen_csops: Heads-up: found a batch of playbook runs that targeted duplicate contact records. We sent healthscore nudges to contact variants for the same customer. Seeing multiple emails to the same account owner.
reza_data: Can you share an example account? I want to trace contact canonicalization.
maddie_onboard: acct-5f3 had two contact records (contact_901 and contact_902) after the import; both mapped as primary because legacy_mapping.priority was NULL.
crm-bot: ingest-log: [2026-06-02T08:21:12Z] import.batch id=imp_20260602 rows=12 dup_contacts=2 duplicates_policy=merge_off
sam_es: Oof. Our dedupe rule expects `legacy_mapping.priority` to be numeric; NULL treated as 0 and both considered equal. We should treat NULL as 'lowest' not equal to other NULLs — or fallback to email normalization.
carmen_csops: Impact: playbook 'healthscore-nudge' fired twice for the same customer within 3 hours. We need to suppress follow-ups and reconcile sent emails.
reza_data: Quick mitigation steps: 1) Pause playbook: `/playbook pause healthscore-nudge --reason "dup-contact hotfix"` 2) Apply a dedupe-hotfix on canonicalization that prefers `contact.is_verified = true` then email_normalized, then id fallback. 3) Run a query to find accounts with >1 primary contact: `SELECT a.id, array_agg(c.id) FROM accounts a JOIN contacts c ON c.account_id=a.id WHERE c.is_primary=true GROUP BY a.id HAVING count(*) > 1;`
maddie_onboard: Also exclude accounts where `onboarding_state != 'complete'` from nudges to avoid mid-onboarding noise.
crm-bot: command acknowledged: healthscore-nudge paused by carmen_csops at 2026-06-02T08:25:01Z reason=dup-contact hotfix
reza_data: I'll push the canary contact canonicalizer to pb-canary-02 with new priority rules. Will run a dry merge on 200 accounts: `python tools/canonicalize_contacts.py --sample 200 --strategy=verified_first`
sam_es: After canonicalization we should add a quick dedupe sentinel in playbook trigger: `AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM outbound_tracker o WHERE o.account=a.id AND o.template='healthscore_nudge' AND o.sent_at > now() - interval '24 hours')` — prevents immediate duplicates.
carmen_csops: Good. Also check whether any automated follow-up emails were scheduled by the sequence engine; cancel queued follow-ups for affected accounts.
maddie_onboard: I'll export affected owners for human outreach. If owners got duplicates, we should send a short note explaining and apologize if necessary. Keep tone: brief + actionable.
reza_data: Canary run results: 200-sample fixed 6 duplicate-primaries and normalized emails; no regressions. Rolling to staging in 10m. Backfill plan: identify duplicates created in last 7 days and collapse to single primary using canary rules, but mark operations as reversible.
crm-bot: queued-job: canonicalize-backfill id=job_998 status=queued
sam_es: Also adding two CI checks: 1) post-import assertion that at most 1 primary contact exists per account, 2) playbook CI to assert dedupe-sentinel exists for any outbound template that can trigger a feedback loop.
carmen_csops: After full backfill, unpause playbook and run an audit to ensure no account got >1 nudge in 24h. If any did, escalate to Owners for manual outreach. Opening CSOPS ticket CSOPS-14200 with owners: reza_data (canonicalize + backfill), maddie_onboard (owner outreach), sam_es (playbook guard), me (postmortem). ETA initial mitigation: 45m. :white_check_mark:
